definitions.explanation: A person who has advanced knowledge in an academic field; a researcher or academic professional.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}な→有名：01106_yuumei⟧{学者|がくしゃ}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{学者|がくしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}している→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧。
examples.english: Many scholars are researching this problem.
My dream was to become a scholar.

notes:
{学者|がくしゃ} refers to a scholar or academic, typically someone who conducts research and has expertise in an academic field.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {学者|がくしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become a scholar)
- 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{学者|がくしゃ} (scholar of ~)
- ⟦{若|わか}い→若い：00823_wakai⟧{学者|がくしゃ} (young scholar)
